reviews.title: Scam Scam Scam Scam
reviews.text: Wow ok so this is the second time i'm writing this and pretty annoyed because as soon as i was going to submit my review it deleted the whole thing. As far as i can tell this app is a scam. It has changed three times since i downloaded it a few months ago. Initially I decided to cash out my coins early to make sure it was not a scam before wasting more time. At the time i could cash out at $2 so i clicked to cash out an amazon gift card. It took me to a separate website that didn't even offer an amazon gift card as an option so I picked one for home depot and it did in fact get sent to my email and i was able to use it. A bit of a red flag but i got money so I continued to use the app, watching tons of adds and walking. But another thing i noticed was that while it says my steps should be maxed out at 20,000 with the level I have since grown my bunny to i still can only max out at 10,000 steps. And there are carrots they say you can give your bunny but no instructions on how or what they do. I believe this is a way to trick you to watch more adds for no benefit to the user. So I decided to cash out again as early as i could which is now $6. I chose an amazon gift card again. This time it didn't bring me to another website but said my gift card will be rewarded to my email on file within 3 days. It's been over three days, i have no email with my reward, i've contacted their email support and filed a claim through their claim form and have heard no response as of yet. I will update this review if anything changes but for now I am certain it is a scam that lures you in initially and then gets you to watch all their adds even more for no payout later. Also, to reviewers, please stop giving 5 stars when you are giving a negative review just so you think it will be seen easier. It gives the app a very misleading star rating and this app is rated pretty great and has a ton of flaws and scam related issues so please give 1 star if you are unhappy with an app. Thanks.
